description: The chart illustrates bias percentages across three topical categories (Sports, Community, Healthcare) and shows “Before” and “After” values for three contact conditions (No Contact, Positive Contact, Negative Contact) using stacked bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories Sports, Community, and Healthcare in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each category, three adjacent stacked bars are shown: a gray bar for “No Contact Before” with a hatched gray segment on top for “No Contact After,” a pink bar for “Positive Contact Before” with a hatched red segment on top for “Positive Contact After,” and a light-blue bar for “Negative Contact Before” with a hatched dark-blue segment on top for “Negative Contact After.” In Sports, the No Contact bar shows 45.42 (before) with a hatched top labeled 7.45 (after segment), the Positive Contact bar shows 43.65 (before) with a hatched top labeled 8.31, and the Negative Contact bar shows 50.05 (before) with a hatched top labeled 8.33. In Community, the No Contact bar shows 38.08 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.00, the Positive Contact bar shows 35.38 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.01, and the Negative Contact bar shows 40.79 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.00. In Healthcare, the No Contact bar shows 40.70 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.00, the Positive Contact bar shows 37.51 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.01, and the Negative Contact bar shows 46.73 (before) with a hatched top labeled 0.11. The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by value, and the “After” components are visually emphasized by diagonal hatching and darker overlay colors, with numeric annotations placed inside the “Before” portions and above the stacked totals for the “After” segment values.
